# opnsense_haproxy_server (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense HAProxy server endpoint.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Backend server address or hostname.
- `name` (String) Unique HAProxy server name.

### Optional

- `advanced` (String) Optional raw HAProxy server parameters.
- `check_down_interval` (String) Optional per-server health-check interval while down.
- `check_interval` (String) Optional per-server health-check interval.
- `check_port` (Number) Optional dedicated health-check port.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable the server. Defaults to `true`.
- `ha_policy` (String) Optional HA policy ID used by the policy-managed HAProxy synchronizer.
- `max_connections` (Number) Optional maximum concurrent connections.
- `mode` (String) Server mode: `active`, `backup`, or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.
- `port` (Number) Backend server TCP port.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether HAProxy establishes TLS to the backend. Keep disabled for raw TCP/TLS passthrough. Defaults to `false`.
- `ssl_ca` (Set of String) OPNsense CA refids trusted when verifying this backend TLS certificate.
- `ssl_sni` (String) TLS SNI hostname sent to this backend server.
- `ssl_verify` (Boolean) Whether HAProxy verifies the backend TLS certificate chain. Defaults to `true`.
- `ssl_verify_host` (String) Optional hostname verified against the backend certificate subject/SAN when ssl_verify=true.
- `type` (String) Server type. Defaults to `static`.
- `weight` (Number) Optional server weight.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the HAProxy server.
